title: 第十九章 我要揍他第二十章 一切以小老板为先
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
苏苗没擅自开门，先是问了叶峥——虽然他们是唐斩月的保镖，但门外的人毕竟是来找叶峥的。
叶峥眉心微蹙，他是不介意唐斩月知道叶家的事，但没打算让她这么早就接触叶家人。
“你慢慢吃，我出去一下。”叶峥起身往外走，他对叶家人太了解了，他不出去，外面的人是不会走的。
唐斩月双眼有些迷蒙，叶峥怎么走啦？诶？赤璃还在啊，那没事了。
她一把捞过赤璃抱怀里蹭。
赤璃享受的眯了眯眼，下一秒，它就被举起来亲了下。
赤璃眼睛瞬间瞪大，整个狐狸都僵住了。
因为不放心唐斩月，保持与赤璃共感的叶峥也僵住了。
他停在原地缓了好几秒，到底没舍得切断共感，只哑声道：“斩月喝多了，麻烦你照顾下。”
苏苗遗憾地看了眼门外，干脆利落地回到餐厅，入眼的画面让她倒吸一口凉气。
——唐斩月正按着赤璃狂吸！
公共场合禁止耍流氓啊！！！
苏苗迅速冲过去，一把控住唐斩月的脑袋，用力往上抬，“赤璃快跑！”
赤璃一个激灵，翻身就跑，冲到叶峥身边就不见了。
苏苗心疼无比，看给人孩子吓的，都不敢在外面呆了。
唐斩月茫然看着自己空空如也的怀抱，她那么大一毛茸茸呢？
苏苗不敢放松，只能呼唤同事，“许枫！别愣着了，快把酒都撤走！”
许枫喉结动了动，深吸一口气才缓缓走向餐厅——喝醉酒的唐斩月也太可怕了！他现在有些担心他工作期间的人身安全。
关上门的叶峥眸光坚定，以后绝不能让唐斩月跟外人喝酒！
“叶峥！你太过分了！”

叶峥抬眸，看向长相跟他有些许相似的中年男人，这是他名义上的大伯，叶季扬。
叶季扬在感情上是烂人一个，却偏偏喜欢立慈父人设，不管是婚生子还是私生子，在他那里都一视同仁，而且他还要求别人也一视同仁。
大家表面上哼哈答应，背地里不是打生打死，就是大肆嘲笑。
这也是老爷子取消其继承人资格的根本原因，连里外都分不清，还怎么管好叶家的产业？真怕他哪天脑子一抽就把家产送人了。
叶峥挑眉，“我怎么过分了？”
“你看看叶武都被你打成什么样了！”叶季扬痛心疾首，“他是你哥哥！”
叶峥面露疑惑，“叶家什么时候多了这号人，家族群里怎么也没人通知。”他作势打开光脑，“我帮大伯公布一下吧，免得以后见了都不认识。”
“不用！”叶季扬连忙阻止，他轻咳道：“这件事我过两天会亲自跟你爷爷说，不用你操心。”
叶峥笑了，“还不是叶家人，就敢当着外人的面给我难堪，大伯啊。”他眼底泛着寒光，“你说，我该不该打他？”
叶季扬猛地转头瞪向叶武，紧跟着一巴掌扇了过去，怒道：“混账！”
旁边的胡诗漫惊呼一声，心疼地摸了摸儿子的脸，口中埋怨道：“儿子本就受了委屈，你还打他！”
叶武垂眸，掩住眼底的怨毒，语气隐忍又可怜，“是他先说我是小三的孩子……”
content_en:
Su Miao didn't open the door without authorization. She asked Ye Zheng first - although they were Tang Zhanyue's bodyguards, the people outside the door were here to see Ye Zheng after all.
Ye Zheng frowned slightly. He didn't mind Tang Zhanyue knowing about the Ye family, but he didn't intend for her to come into contact with the Ye family so early.
"You eat slowly, I'll go out for a while." Ye Zheng stood up and walked out. He knew the Ye family very well. If he didn't go out, people outside would not leave.
Tang Zhanyue's eyes were a little blurry. Why did Ye Zheng leave? Eh? Chili is still there, then it’s okay.
She picked up Chili and hugged her.
Chili narrowed her eyes in enjoyment, and the next second, she was lifted up and kissed.
Chili's eyes widened instantly, and the entire fox froze.
Because he was worried about Tang Zhanyue, Ye Zheng, who still felt the same way as Chili, also froze.
He stopped in place and calmed down for a few seconds. In the end, he was not willing to cut off the empathy, so he said hoarsely: "Zangetsu drank too much, please take care of me."
Su Miao glanced at the door with regret, then returned to the restaurant neatly. The scene that caught her eye made her take a breath.
——Tang Zhanyue was pressing the red glass and sucking wildly!
No hooliganism is allowed in public places! ! !
Su Miao quickly rushed over, grabbed Tang Zhanyue's head, and lifted it up with force, "Chili, run!"
Chi Li jumped up, turned over and ran away. He rushed to Ye Zheng and disappeared.
Su Miao felt extremely distressed. Seeing how frightened the children were, she didn't dare to stay outside anymore.
Tang Zhanyue looked at his empty arms blankly. How could she be so big and hairy?
Su Miao didn't dare to relax, so she could only call to her colleagues, "Xu Feng! Don't be stunned, take away the wine quickly!"
Xu Feng's Adam's apple twitched, and he took a deep breath before slowly walking towards the restaurant - the drunk Tang Zhanyue was too scary! He now has some concerns about his personal safety while working.
Ye Zheng's eyes were firm as he closed the door. Tang Zhanyue would never be allowed to drink with outsiders in the future!
"Ye Zheng! You've gone too far!"
Ye Zheng raised his eyes and looked at the middle-aged man who looked slightly similar to him. This was his nominal uncle, Ye Jiyang.
Ye Jiyang is a bad person emotionally, but he likes to be a loving father. He treats children equally whether they are legitimate children or illegitimate children, and he also requires others to treat them equally.
On the surface, everyone agreed, but behind the scenes, they either beat him to death or laughed at him.
This is also the fundamental reason why the old man disqualified him as the heir. How can he manage the Ye family's property if he can't even tell the inside from the outside? I'm really afraid that one day he'll get mad and give away his family property.
Ye Zheng raised his eyebrows, "Why did I go too far?"
"Look at how Ye Wu was beaten by you!" Ye Jiyang was heartbroken, "He is your brother!"
Ye Zheng looked confused, "When did this person appear in the Ye family? No one in the family notified him." He pretended to turn on his optical brain, "Let me announce it to my uncle, so that I won't recognize him when I meet him in the future."
"No need!" Ye Jiyang stopped him quickly and coughed lightly: "I will tell your grandpa personally about this in two days, so you don't need to worry about it."
Ye Zheng smiled, "You're not from the Ye family, but you dare to embarrass me in front of outsiders, uncle." There was a cold light in his eyes, "Do you think I should hit him?"
Ye Jiyang suddenly turned his head and glared at Ye Wu, then slapped him and said angrily: "Bastard!"
Hu Shiman next to him exclaimed, touched his son's face distressedly, and complained: "My son has been wronged, and you still beat him!"
Ye Wu lowered his eyes, covering up the resentment in his eyes, and his tone was forbearing and pitiful, "He was the first to say that I was the mistress's child..."
